hypothesis: A larger SQuAD2-trained RoBERTa reader may improve exact-span answer extraction on identical frozen retrieval contexts compared with MiniLM.
validation: 29 reused Dorian questions plus four authored unknown controls; frozen v2 expanded fine96/top12 contexts
rights_status: Public domain in the USA; check local rights. Original short story 1846.
fresh_selection_basis: One short official public-domain test story chosen by source metadata and bounded retrieval cost, before QA inspection. This is not a representative long-novel benchmark.
selection: Validation F1 minus 0.25 times authored-control false-answer rate; ties EM, larger threshold, smaller penalty, then MiniLM model order. Serialize before fresh question access.
fresh_retrieval_corpus: Only the prespecified short-story source; unsupervised source index, no summaries or QA answers indexed.
fresh_inference: Only selected reader and validation-selected threshold/rank; exactly one fresh test pass, no tuning from outcomes. Question and gold files remain separate.
compute: One private free Kaggle GPU kernel, sequential readers, hard 900-second process watchdog including installation/download. Launch only after root confirms audio GPU terminal.
historical_tests_preserved: A Sentimental Journey Through France and Italy
fallback: If fresh retrieval or dependencies cannot fit the bounded pass, preserve partial evidence and report validation-only scope; do not invent a held-out score.
